search_text: published ZDI-23-1533 ZDI-CAN-21255 Magnet Forensics AXIOM Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-10-06 CVE-2023-42128 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-42128 8.0 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Magnet Forensics'] ['AXIOM'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Magnet Forensics AXIOM. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must acquire data from a malicious mobile device. The specific flaw exists within the Android device image acquisition functionality. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Fixed in AXIOM v7.6 ['2023-09-05 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-10-06 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrew Clark IV https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1533/
title: Magnet Forensics AXIOM Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Magnet Forensics AXIOM. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must acquire data from a malicious mobile device. The specific flaw exists within the Android device image acquisition functionality. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
